summary: Frontend-only UI check of the blue restyle, run with Playwright at 1920px and 390px against the live Java backend. Every requested flow passed. (1) Two-step login: the role picker shows all 3 cards, clicking a card opens the form with a role title, the change-role button goes back, and a wrong password shows login-error ('ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است'). Redirects follow the real account role, not the card: the patient account via the admin card went to /patient, the physician via the patient card to /physician, the admin via the physician card to /admin, and the pending account to /pending. (2) Register: a TEST_ user registered and was sent to /pending. (3) Desktop shell: the sidebar user card shows the name and role, the nav works, and header-page-title matches every patient page. header-today shows the Jalali date. The bell links to /patient/appointments. The count badge appeared (۱) after a TEST_ appointment due within the reminder window was created, and was correctly hidden when there were 0 reminders. Sidebar logout works and guards /patient. (4) Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on any of the 5 patient pages, bottom nav works, header logout works. (5) Dashboard hero: greeting '<name> عزیز', cancer type 'سرطان تیروئید پاپیلاری', and the next-visit box with Jalali date and physician name, which links to appointments. The medications, labs, medical summary, care team, completeness and coming-soon cards all render. (6) Smoke: the lab chart renders (recharts); the lab dialog's close X sits on the left in RTL; medications and appointments render; the physician list opens patient detail; all 5 admin tabs render with stats.

issues: The form card sits far left with a large empty gap between it and the brand panel. Centering it in its column or narrowing the gap would match image1 more closely (minor).
The page title and Jalali date are hidden below lg (lg:hidden), so mobile users see only the brand. Optional: show the page title on mobile.
Shows the date only, without the time or appointment title. Optional: add the time, e.g. formatJalali(..., true).

action_items: Optional cleanup: remove the unused NextAppointment component in PatientDashboard.jsx (dead code that reuses data-testid 'dashboard-next-appointment').
critical_code_review_comments: PatientDashboard.jsx: the NextAppointment component (lines 43-56) is defined but never rendered. It duplicates a testid used by the hero box.
AppShell.jsx: lucide-react is imported in two separate import statements (Bell, then the others). Merge them (cosmetic).
The tailwind teal-to-blue remap works, but the class names (bg-teal-700) no longer describe the colour, which may confuse future edits.

The card does not restrict the role; the redirect uses the actual account role. Java backend on 8001 was up. Browser clock reads Nov 2026 (Jalali 1405). For a bell-count test, create a patient appointment 3h ahead with remind_before_minutes=1440 using fetch inside the page with credentials:'include', then delete it. Admin tab testids: admin-tab-approvals/users/physician/assign/audit. Physician rows: [data-testid^=physician-patient-row-].
